refresh_token.rotation_description: Issue new refresh token on each use for enhanced security

environment_variables.fallback_warning: Using fallback secrets is only allowed in development. Set JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET in production.

optional_fields.email: string - User email for audit logs
optional_fields.deviceId: string - Device identifier for multi-device support

best_practices.rotate_secrets_regularly: Rotate JWT secrets every 90 days minimum
best_practices.use_https_only: Always transmit JWT tokens over HTTPS in production
best_practices.store_secrets_securely: Store JWT secrets in environment variables or secret management systems (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault)
best_practices.implement_token_rotation: Implement refresh token rotation for enhanced security (already enabled in this config)
best_practices.cleanup_expired_tokens: Regularly clean up expired tokens from database (scheduled daily at 2 AM)
best_practices.audit_token_usage: Log token generation and validation for security auditing (enabled)
best_practices.implement_rate_limiting: Rate limit authentication endpoints to prevent brute force attacks (configured)
best_practices.monitor_token_theft: Monitor for suspicious patterns indicating token theft (enabled)
best_practices.use_secure_cookies: Store tokens in httpOnly, secure cookies instead of localStorage
best_practices.implement_logout_everywhere: Provide users ability to revoke all tokens across devices
best_practices.regular_security_audits: Conduct regular security audits of JWT implementation

implementation_notes.compatibility: Both implementations must maintain feature parity
implementation_notes.testing: All changes must include tests in both TypeScript and Python
